subject: Portal ownership handoff & credential rotation
messages:
From: Portal Ops <portal-ops@vendrsecurity.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: onboarding <onboarding@vendrsecurity.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood: Portal ownership transfer & API key rotation

Hi Rohan,

We are preparing to transfer portal ownership for the Redwood account and rotate credentials that Vendr currently holds on your behalf. Attached is a short onboarding manifest showing the assets we have linked to your org (vendr_onboarding_manifest.csv).

Ask: please confirm an ownership handoff window this week (we have availability Oct 4–6) and the primary Red­wood contact who will execute the rotation on your side. The rotation will cover:
- API keys used by Redwood services to call Vendr APIs
- A service S3 credential stored as an integration in your portal
- The portal admin transfer in our OneTrust/Whistic-style UI

Pre-rotation checklist (we will provide a runbook as soon as window is confirmed):
1) Confirm owner and a secondary observer
2) Snapshot any integrator tokens used by background jobs
3) Ensure a rollback plan and temporary access window

We also need a signed ownership transfer form (vendr-portal-ownership-form.pdf). If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign link.

Attachements: vendr_onboarding_manifest.csv, vendr-portal-ownership-form.pdf

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Portal Ops — Vendr Security
portal-ops@vendrsecurity.com

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Portal Ops <portal-ops@vendrsecurity.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood: Portal ownership transfer & API key rotation

Thanks Maya — got the manifest and the form.

We can do the handoff on Monday, Oct 4 at 10:00–11:00 PT. Vivek will perform the rotation and Monica will validate post-rotation telemetry and access. A few quick asks from our side before we lock the window:
- Send the full runbook you plan to follow (step-by-step command list or portal clicks)
- Confirm whether the rotation requires any short-lived downtime for the API (we aim for zero downtime but need to know if a 1–2 minute rekey window exists)
- Please send the DocuSign link for the ownership transfer so legal can sign prior to the window

If we get the runbook and DocuSign link today we can proceed Monday. Vivek — can you confirm availability for that slot? Monica — can you take point on validation?

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <maya@vendrsecurity.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Portal Ops <portal-ops@vendrsecurity.com>, onboarding <onboarding@vendrsecurity.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood: Portal ownership transfer & API key rotation

Hi Rohan — thanks, that window works.

Runbook summary (full PDF attached in portal and mirrored here):
1) We will open a temporary owner role for the nominated user and add a 24-hour elevated access token
2) Vendor Ops triggers a backend API key rotation: we create a new API key, push it to your staging token endpoint, and enable dual-keys for 10 minutes
3) Your team switches the service to the new key and confirms successful calls; we monitor error rate and roll back if it exceeds 0.5% in the first 5 minutes
4) We revoke the old key once both sides confirm

Impact: expected < 1 minute of elevated error rates during cutover; no scheduled downtime. If you prefer a true zero-risk cutover we can do a dark‑launch and catch-up sync, but that requires extra coordination.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/transfer/ABCD1234 (I also attached docsign_transfer-link.txt to this reply).
Portal: https://portal.vendrsecurity.com/organizations/redwood
Attachments: vendr_onboarding_manifest.csv (again), vendr-rotation-runbook.pdf (available in portal)

> Thanks Maya — got the manifest and the form.
>
> We can do the handoff on Monday, Oct 4 at 10:00–11:00 PT. Vivek will perform the rotation and Monica will validate post-rotation telemetry and access.

Looking forward — we will be online during the window to confirm.

Maya
Portal Ops — Vendr Security

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood: Portal ownership transfer & API key rotation — Monday runbook & responsibilities

Folks — forwarding the vendor confirmation and runbook. Quick assignment:
- Vivek: you own the rotation execution at 10:00 PT. Follow Vendr's runbook exactly and keep the dual-key phase active for 10 minutes.
- Monica: verify that telemetry (500/502 spikes, auth failures) stays within expected thresholds and run a quick smoke test hitting these endpoints: /v1/usage, /v1/models/status, /internal/health. Please sign off in the channel when green.
- I will countersign the DocuSign transfer after legal gives the OK (link below).

Attachments from vendor: vendr_onboarding_manifest.csv, vendr-portal-ownership-form.pdf (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/transfer/ABCD1234)

If anything unexpected happens we stop and escalate to Vendor Ops immediately.

Thanks — R
